study_identification_part.si_4_title: Analyzing heterogeneity in Alzheimer disease using multimodal normative modeling on imaging-based ATN biomarkers

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ADNI was the discovery dataset; the Charles F. and Joanne Knight ADRC dataset was the replication dataset.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We constructed a discovery dataset consisting of individuals from ADNI and a replication dataset consisting of individuals from the Charles F. and Joanne Knight ADRC dataset at Washington University in St. Louis."

answer.ADNI: reference control group (ADNI-CU) for normative model training/validation/testing; ADNI-ADS as target disease group

answer.Knight ADRC-ADS: replication dataset: ADRC-CU for transfer-learning training/validation/testing; ADRC-ADS as target disease group

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: ADNI-CU split into train/holdout/test for model training and standardization; ADRC-CU split into transfer-learning train/holdout/test for replication. ADNI-ADS and ADRC-ADS are the disease cohorts.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "(1) a reference control group of amyloid-negative CU ... used to train the deep learning-based normative model; and (2) a target disease group of amyloid positive individuals across the ADS." ... "The ADNI-CU group was further divided into a training set for model training (ADNI-CU-train; n = 326), a holdout validation set (ADNI-CU-holdout; n = 65), and a test set (ADNI-CU-test; n = 43)..." ... "Similarly, the ADRC-CU group was also divided into a training set for transfer learning on the replication dataset (ADRC-CU-tl; n = 225), a holdout validation set (ADRC-CU-holdout; n = 45), and a test set (ADRC-CU-test; n = 31)."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Overall healthy control counts come from ADNI-CU and ADRC-CU totals; train-phase counts from ADNI-CU-train and ADRC-CU-tl.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "A total of 434 amyloid-negative CU participants were included in the reference control group (ADNI-CU)... For ADRC, the reference group (ADRC-CU) consisted of 301 amyloid-negative CU individuals..." ... "ADNI-CU-train; n = 326" ... "ADRC-CU-tl; n = 225"

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall-phase age mean and SD reported for ADNI-CU and ADRC-CU; train-phase ages not reported.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall-phase sex counts reported for ADNI-CU and ADRC-CU; percentages calculated from totals. Train-phase sex counts not reported.
